reassessment_note: Weekly desk 2026-08-22: The single thesis that broke this week is the crypto short: BTC's violent run from ~$63k to ~$78k flipped crypto-proxy equities into a confirmed bull move (COIN +8.2% on 8/21 alone, now well above where the hedge was sized on 7/30), directly invalidating the 'crypto's ongoing bear market' rationale behind the COIN short hedge. Covering it rather than holding a broken-thesis short into further squeeze risk. Every other name in the book was checked individually this week (MSFT, GOOGL, AVGO, META, UNH, COST, XOM, IWM) and each GARP thesis is intact or strengthening -- no other changes warranted. Parking the freed hedge capital in cash (earning 4% APY) rather than forcing a replacement short without a researched frothy-speculative candidate; will revisit the hedge leg next week.
